combo_label: Takeaways × Baking & Cakes × The Wild West

entries.clue: White-fleshed North Atlantic fish, dipped in batter and fried for the classic supper
Jangling spiked wheels strapped at the heels of riding boots
Where the driver hands the hot bag over, or a very thickly cut slice of bread
Conical hide lodge of the plains, its poles lashed at the apex
The moving edge of settlement, where the maps ran out
Hot restaurant curry that borrows the former name of the city now called Chennai
Sticky barbecue-glazed pork bones, gnawed clean as a starter before the main course
Long-handled wooden shovel that slides loaves onto the oven floor
Ingredients, quantities and instructions, all on one handed-down card
Rounded top that a well-risen bake pushes itself up into
Woven strips criss-crossed over the top of a fruit pie before baking
Panicked mass charge of hooves that flattens everything ahead
